2610.09043.title: Careful Judge: Safe and Efficient Human-AI Collaborative Decision Making
2610.09043.paper_summary: In human-AI collaborative decision making, human review can prevent unsafe AI decisions, but each human judgment is costly. Treating human intervention after AI abstention as a one-off fallback misses the opportunity to improve future AI decisions for greater automation, yet AI adaptively learning from selectively queried human feedback breaks safety guardrails calibrated for old models. We approach this challenge with CARE---calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation---an end-to-end pipeline that combines AI models and human reviewers to guarantee safe, human-aligned decisions, while continuously learning from human feedback to achieve greater automation with fewer human queries. CARE is principled, general, modular, and works with any black-box AI model. Our novel adaptive calibration module guarantees risk control at every time step for any rectification module. We further show how CARE improves query efficiency when the AI model is well trained and the human-AI misalignment has a clear structure. Experiments on four safety-critical real-world datasets spanning driving, language, and robotics demonstrate that CARE achieves human-aligned decisions while reducing human queries by 25-81% relative to baselines.
2610.09043.paper_summary_zh: 在人類與人工智慧的協作決策中，人類審查可以防止不安全的人工智慧決策，但每一次人類判斷都是有成本的。將人工介入視為人工智慧放棄後的一次性備用措施，錯失了改善未來人工智慧決策以實現更大自動化的機會，然而，人工智慧從選擇性查詢的人類反饋中自適應學習，則打破了為舊模型校準的安全防護措施。我們用CARE來應對這一挑戰——校準的自適應修正和升級——這是一個端到端的流程，結合了人工智慧模型和人類審查者，以保證安全且符合人類需求的決策，同時不斷從人類反饋中學習，以實現更高的自動化，並減少人類查詢次數。CARE是原則性、通用性、模塊化的，並且可以與任何黑箱人工智慧模型協同工作。我們的新型自適應校準模塊保證了在每一時間步驟中對任何修正模塊的風險控制。我們進一步展示了當人工智慧模型訓練良好且人類與人工智慧之間的不一致性具有明確結構時，CARE如何提高查詢效率。在四個涉及駕駛、語言和機器人技術的安全關鍵真實世界數據集上的實驗表明，CARE在實現符合人類需求的決策的同時，相對於基準減少了25-81%的人工查詢。
